mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_sales_order WHERE sales_approve_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_sales_order WHERE sales_approve_status = '1' AND finance_approve_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN finance_approve_status = '1' THEN order_total ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount, 0 as receiptAmount FROM mis_sales_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT id, order_no as orderNo, customer_name as customerName, salesman_name as salesmanName, order_total as orderTotal, sales_approve_status as salesApproveStatus, finance_approve_status as financeApproveStatus, create_time as createTime FROM mis_sales_order WHERE (sales_approve_status = '0' OR finance_approve_status = '0') AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_total), 0) FROM mis_sales_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND finance_approve_status = '1' AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(receipt_amount), 0) FROM mis_receipt_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(receipt_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND status = '1' AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_price_offer WHERE approve_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_sales_order WHERE (finance_approve_status = '0' OR sales_approve_status = '0') AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_customer WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) FROM mis_sales_payment_plan WHERE DATE_FORMAT(plan_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND unpaid_amount > 0 AND del_flag = '0'
AND salesman_id = #{salesmanId}

SELECT p.product_name as productName, COALESCE(SUM(sod.order_qty), 0) as totalQty, COALESCE(SUM(sod.detail_amount), 0) as totalAmount FROM mis_sales_order_detail sod LEFT JOIN mis_sales_order so ON sod.order_id = so.id LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON sod.product_id = p.id WHERE so.finance_approve_status = '1' AND so.del_flag = '0' AND sod.del_flag = '0'
AND so.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
AND so.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)
AND DATE_FORMAT(so.order_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
AND so.salesman_id = #{salesmanId}
GROUP BY sod.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT m.salesman_id as salesmanId, MAX(m.salesman_name) as salesmanName, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.order_total), 0) as orderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.receipt_amount), 0) as collectionAmount FROM mis_sales_order m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sales_order_id, SUM(receipt_amount) as receipt_amount FROM mis_receipt_order_detail WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY sales_order_id ) d ON m.id = d.sales_order_id WHERE m.finance_approve_status = '1' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.salesman_id IS NOT NULL
AND m.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
AND m.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)
AND m.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
GROUP BY m.salesman_id ORDER BY orderAmount DESC LIMIT 5
